text.p: Election campaign events scheduled for Tuesday include:
- Labour leader Tony Blair and deputy leader John Prescott travel to Basildon, a key marginal seat.
- Labour economics spokesman Gordon Brown and deputy leader John Prescott visit Great Yarmouth at 1830 GMT.
- Arthur Scargill's Socialist Labour Party holds manifesto launch at Westminster Central Hall 1500 BST/1400GMT.
- Formal dissolution of parliament at 1530 GMT.
- Welsh nationalists, Plaid Cymru, hold news conference 1030 GMT City Hall, Cardiff, to launch manifesto.

- Conservative member of parliament Neil Hamilton, under fire for sleaze allegations, faces formal adoption meeting of local Conservative members in his Tatton constituency -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
